Its front wall is 1.50 m back from that lot line, which is the closest line the plat module's own margin allows and is not a measurement of this frontage, and its east wall is fixed by the west wall of recon_1835_blk_south_water_lasalle_d4_02, which it shares a party line with. The bearing is the face's own, so the front looks square at South Water Street. The run carries no lateral offset, because a shared party wall is one wall and cannot wander. WHAT IS INVENTED IS STILL EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS: that a building stood here at all, which building it was, and that these particular units stood shoulder to shoulder. What the 1834 South Water Street view supports is the TREATMENT — a continuous working row of party walls rather than detached cottages set back on grass. The treatment is what this placement takes from it, and a run standing on any other face of the town is borrowing it from that one street: the view draws a row, it does not place this row. Standing on a derived block face is not standing on a recovered lot, and the side lot lines this row crosses were always conjectural.

A BOUND FROM THE RECORD, NOT AN ARRIVAL. tax_1833 stands against this person's name by 31 December 1833 and nothing says when they came. THE 1833 TAX LIST IS A PROPERTY ROLL, NOT A RESIDENCE CHECK (T-1117): it names the owner of ground inside the town, resident or not, and its own entry 110 is a man three years dead. It bounds the town's RECORD of this name and not the day this person reached Chicago. G.” (tax_1833_115, line 167); Election returns — poll list of 1834, filed 11 August 1834 — “Wright, T. G.” (poll_1834_115, line 284). The Illinois State Archives' Public Domain Land Tract Sales register enters this person 11 times, as “WRIGHT T G”, “WRIGHT TRUMAN G”, 1833-10-22 to 1836-06-24: 2 federal land entries — SWFR sec 34 T40N R14E; W2NW sec 08 T40N R14E and 3 lots in the platted town — lot 1 of block 52 in the town the register codes CHIOTV (L1BL52CHIOTV, as printed); lot 2 of block 52 in the town the register codes CHIOTV (L2BL52CHIOTV, as printed); lot 7 of block 57 in the town the register codes CHIOT (L7BL57CHIOT, as printed) and 6 parcels of the school section — BL51 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E), as read; BL69 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E), as read; lot 1 of block 70 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E); lot 2 of block 70 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E); lot 3 of block 70 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E); lot 4 of block 70 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E), 90.61 acres stated in all, for $21482.00 (ls0393, ls0394, ls0395, ls0396, ls0397, ls0398, ls1569, ls1570, ls1571, ls0518, ls0566). frontage.why: T-0078, and the owner's standing ruling of 2026-08-18 with it: "there should be more and denser buildings. this is important." The reference he supplied for this reach — "South Water Street in 1834", the south bank of the Main Branch — shows a CONTINUOUS WORKING ROW: one-storey log and frame buildings shoulder to shoulder facing the river, the street between them and the grassy bank, two-storey frame stores anchoring its east end. This block's anonymous roofs stood seven metres back from that frontage, a full lot apart, each nudged off the line by its own lateral offset and — because the placement rule takes its bearing from the way into the lot — facing the block's interior rather than the river. That is the shape of a distribution across a block, not of a street. They now stand ON the frontage: the line, its bearing and the end they pack back from are read from the committed block boundary in data/traces/vectors/thompson_lots.json, and this recipe authors no coordinate for any of them. The 1.5 m setback is not a measurement of this frontage — it is the closest line the plat module's own lot margin allows, adopted so the street wall is one wall. NO ROOF IS ADDED: the run carries exactly the roofs the schedule dealt this block's frontage lots, with every id, family and dimension the one it already had. What the view drives is the treatment — a row on its line, facing the water — never a coordinate, and the side lot lines the row crosses between its own units were conjectural in every record this generator has ever written.
